## Reflection

Building and deploying this website was a valuable learning experience that strengthened both my technical and creative skills. Throughout the process, I became more confident in structuring content, organizing files, and understanding how each component contributes to a functional site. Writing and refining the pages helped me think more clearly about my goals, audience, and how to communicate information effectively.

Deploying the site was especially rewarding because it transformed my work from something local and personal into something public and accessible. Troubleshooting issues—whether with formatting, links, or hosting—taught me patience and gave me a stronger sense of ownership over the final product. I also gained a better understanding of version control, publishing workflows, and the importance of testing before release.

Overall, this project helped me grow as a learner and creator. It showed me that building a website isn’t just about technical steps; it’s also about expressing ideas, making decisions, and adapting when challenges appear. The final result reflects both effort and progress, and it motivates me to keep improving in future digital projects.

## Website Overview

My website contains a collection of curated pages that showcase my work, interests, and learning progress. It includes summaries, visuals, and structured sections that highlight key concepts, personal reflections, and analytical insights. The site is organized for clarity and easy navigation, presenting my projects in a clean, professional format suitable for both academic and personal use.
